name: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd
title: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd - 500110 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Record 11.71 MMT throughput (112% of 10.5 MMT capacity) and Q4 GRM $13.75/bbl, but management concedes ~$10.3 core and export duties/RTP cap are pressuring net cracks; capex modest at INR2,000 crore over 2-3 years.

utilisation.quote: highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity

capex.quote: Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing

triggers.label: Throughput 112% of capacity FY26
triggers.quote: highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT

triggers.label: Net cracks near long-term average
triggers.quote: The net GRM based on realized RTP is pretty close to the long-term average.

triggers.label: INR2,000 crore capex over 2-3 years
triggers.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

guidance.value: INR2,000 crore over 2-3 years plus ~INR500 crore annual normal capex
guidance.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years. Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

guidance.value: No M&I in first 6 months of FY27; scheduled M&I near Sept-Oct
guidance.quote: in the first 6 months, we don't see any M&I. So it may not be there.

red_flags.label: Export duty and RTP pressure on net cracks
red_flags.quote: The net GRM based on realized RTP is pretty close to the long-term average.

red_flags.label: Forex loss in other expenses
red_flags.quote: for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

red_flags.label: Middle East crude supply disruption
red_flags.quote: What has impacted i s that maybe 30% to 40% was affected over a very short period

red_flags.label: Management evasion on RTP and crude premiums
red_flags.quote: I think it will not be appropriate for me to deliberate on RTP pricing.

evasions.topic: RTP discount and export duty impact on margins
evasions.quote: I think it will not be appropriate for me to deliberate on RTP pricing.
I will not assign anything as profit forgone because I'm selling at market price
